name: AI background remover
description: Isolate portraits, signatures, or products onto a transparent PNG or studio backdrop locally using BEN v2 / MODNet via ONNX Runtime WebGPU (~120ms per photo).

seo.metaTitle: AI background remover — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Isolate portraits, signatures, or products onto a transparent PNG or studio backdrop locally using BEN v2 / MODNet via ONNX Runtime WebGPU (~120ms per photo). Runs 100% locally in your browser via modnet-ben-v2-fp16 with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: AI background remover processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using modnet-ben-v2-fp16 (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does AI background remover upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. AI background remover executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using modnet-ben-v2-fp16. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate AI background remover?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/bg_remove.json or open /tools/bg-remove?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
